svg.title: Transpile Witness: compiler observations, layout and replay
svg.desc: Original quantum programmes, compiler frames, explicit maps and supplier observations preserve different kinds of evidence. Exact output-byte replay and independent native-outcome replay remain separate; equal negative checker results remain negative. Genuine Common interfaces and domain evaluation are part of a certificate workflow still under development. Offline source reading; no compiler, checker, converter or QPU executed.

g.text: ANULUM / QUANTUM COMPUTING SYSTEMS
Transpile Witness: observations, layout and replay
In progress · source reading 2026-10-20 · certificate and complete evaluator integration remain open
1 / RETAIN THE ORIGINAL COMPARISON PROBLEM AND ITS OBSERVATIONS
Original circuit pair
Source + compiled QASM / QPY
Original dependencies and profiles
Explicit wire order and semantics
Keep missing / refused members
Compiler observations
Ordered actual callback frames
Original output and SDK settings
Initial / final / logical wire maps
Ancilla roles and widths explicit
Native checker results
QCEC / PyZX, fixed owned routes
Native verdict, settings and streams
Errors / timeouts remain visible
Observation is not eligibility
2 / TWO DIFFERENT REPLAY QUESTIONS
Original output-byte replay
Compare the complete original and repeated QPY bytes
Equal / different / unavailable, lengths and first offset
Never normalise a differing serialisation to make it pass
Equal files do not prove compiler-wide determinism
Independent engine replay
Same original problem; distinct witness / evaluation runs
Retain all source, profile, request and conversion joins
Definite negatives can match and remain negative
Failed or undecided observations stay unavailable
Evidence lifecycle in progress: witness / seal / verify / inspect / render
Source selects genuine Evidence Manifest Toolkit interfaces; Common custody and domain decisions stay separate.
Complete native / C0 subjects, claims, policy, ordered members and source observations retain their identities.
Candidate capture, Common success or a rendered document does not supply complete qualified domain verification.
3 / KEEP REPRESENTATION, SCIENCE AND EXECUTION SCOPE DISTINCT
Route-specific interpretation
PyZX False means reduction did not succeed
The affected QASM2 phase route cannot prove unitary_exact
QCEC phase / probabilistic vocabulary stays intact
Separate workers still share conversion dependencies
Before domain eligibility
Valid maps do not prove quantum equivalence
Process / memory / Clock / runtime need qualification
Whole evaluator and final report integration stay open
Offline library: no circuit submission to a QPU
Concrete contributor and partner responsibilities
Supplier/profile and converter review; independently supported circuit, phase, ancilla and measurement cases.
Actual Common and domain consumer integration; complete source, process, Clock and sensitive-data custody.
These are required roles, not agreed partners, acquired infrastructure or completed scientific acceptance.
Mapping, raw byte identity, native outcome consistency and current certificate eligibility are separate claims.
Selected original source bytes retain complete reading views and hashes; no source commit or release is implied.
No compiler / checker / converter / QPU execution · source-owner and scientific / publication review pending
